description: Frozen decisions for the DEL-12-02 input-contract sweep (input_contract_sweep.json), one symbol per case in sweep order; a symbol indexes `alphabet` and names the `codes` entry `action/reason_code` at that index. The `*_before` columns are each implementation's decisions before the input contract, captured from the real code at 4df12af82d (Python core/security/redaction/controls.py; TypeScript redactionExportControls.ts; Rust the #[cfg(test)] mirror in core/runner/headless/src/redaction_binding.rs, built through the T3 cargo wrapper). Python's `raised/TypeError` is the TypeError it raised on an array or object label. `contract` is the decision all three give under the input contract (HELP_HUMAN ruling 2026-10-27); each implementation's test asserts it case for case, and that no case is less strict than any `*_before` column under `action_order` (least to most strict). The cases from index 74,760 on (the alias_items and alias_projector families, appended with the HELP_HUMAN decision of 2026-10-27 on the `classification` alias) were captured the same way from the real code at 7952682ab7, before the TypeScript projector read the alias only when `privacy_classification` is absent; the Rust mirror then had no route projector, so its column holds `not_mirrored/NO_ROUTE_PROJECTOR` for the alias_projector cases, which the tests skip as they skip `raised/TypeError`. Codes are append-only.
